item.title: Workspaces incorrectly moves main chrome window instead of PWA app
item.author: KKhanhH

judgment.rationale: Workspaces moves an existing Chrome window when it should move or launch a Chrome PWA. The arranger matching code accepts a normal browser window when path/name matches and PWA IDs are empty or unresolved, fitting the symptom.
evidence: Workspace contains Google Chat/Calendar/Gmail PWAs; a normal Chrome window is moved instead.
origin/main WindowArranger::GetNearestWindow compares app name/path and pwaAppId after best-effort PWA detection.
Merged PR #35913 implemented PWA recognition/launching, confirming ownership area.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a Workspaces PWA matching fix that requires positive PWA identity before matching browser-backed PWA entries to existing browser windows.

fix_assessment.rationale: No current fix was found; the matching predicate has an obvious browser/PWA false-positive boundary.

proposed_fixes.title: Require PWA identity when moving existing browser-backed workspace apps
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Existing-window matching can fall back to chrome.exe path/name when PWA app id detection is empty, allowing a normal Chrome window to satisfy a saved PWA entry.
plan: For saved browser PWA entries, require non-empty detected appData.pwaAppId equality.
Do not let app.path == appData.installPath match a normal Chrome window for a PWA entry.
Log unresolved PWA identity and launch the missing PWA instead of moving unrelated Chrome.
Add tests for normal Chrome vs saved PWA.
verification: Activate workspace with Gmail/Calendar/Chat PWAs and normal Chrome open; normal Chrome must not move.

confidence.rationale: Predicate matches symptom; sanitized workspace JSON would confirm empty/stale PWA id.

issue_context.summary: Workspaces can treat a normal Chrome window as one of the saved Google PWA windows when activating a workspace.
known_information: Two PWAs already launched and a normal Chrome window sits on the target monitor.
Remaining PWA launches on top of the moved Chrome window.
inferences: Saved or detected PWA identity may be empty/stale, causing path fallback to match chrome.exe.
issue_context.analysis: Browser PWAs share the Chrome process path, so PWA workspace entries need stronger identity matching than normal apps.
initial_investigation: Read live activity through 2026-09-02T16:49:44Z; no comments beyond labels.
Checked origin/main WorkspacesWindowArranger and SnapshotUtils PWA flow at 5abd20e355998a865075a06676bebfc1d9925be4.
Public PR search surfaced merged PWA recognition PR #35913.

information_gaps.information: Sanitized Workspaces project JSON for the affected PWA entries, especially name/path/pwaAppId.
information_gaps.why_needed: Confirms whether the false match is caused by missing, stale, or mismatched PWA identity.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Comment /bugreport after reproducing, or paste affected Workspaces entries with personal URLs/titles removed.

design.root_cause: Path/name fallback lets normal Chrome match a PWA workspace entry when PWA id is missing.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Matches by app name or install path and pwaAppId equality, including both empty.
implementation_steps.change: For saved PWA entries, require current non-empty pwaAppId equality before match.
implementation_steps.code_block: if (savedPwa) { if (appData.pwaAppId.empty() || app.pwaAppId != appData.pwaAppId) continue; } else if (!(nameOrPathMatch)) continue;
edge_cases: Older workspaces with missing PWA ids may need recapture/migration.
Normal browser workspace entries should still match.
tests: Unit-test normal Chrome not matching saved Gmail PWA.

risks: Old PWA workspaces may launch duplicates until recaptured.
alternatives: Keep path fallback rejected because it causes wrong-window moves.

comment.body: This looks like Workspaces is matching normal `chrome.exe` by browser path instead of requiring the saved PWA identity. Please provide a fresh `/bugreport` after reproducing, or paste the affected Workspaces app entries with personal URLs/titles removed. The important fields are saved app name, path, and `pwaAppId`.
